confidence_rules.high: explicit entity name tag from a block-explorer label set (Etherscan via GitHub datasets, Blockscout/OLI name tag) or an entity-named Nansen label
confidence_rules.medium: generic explorer category ("Fund", "OTC") with the entity only in the name tag, Blockscout generic tag, or Nansen 30D/90D/180D Smart Trader (behavioural, not an entity)

nansen_fund_cohort_note: entity "Nansen Fund-cohort wallet (entity unnamed)" = address returned by Nansen tgm/holders with the Fund label filter (medium: Nansen classifies it as a fund wallet; which fund is a premium label we did not buy)

not_used.Arkham: API requires key; entity pages require login
not_used.news/disclosures: no address list found that could be verified without a key; nothing added by hand (no invented labels)

caveats: Explorer labels can be stale (2023 snapshot in brianleect) and an entity can control many unlabeled wallets.
Exchange deposit addresses tagged to a fund (e.g. "Galaxy Digital: HTX Deposit") are swept by the exchange.
Addresses tagged Compromised are kept but excluded from flags.

wallets.note: Blockscout tag "Compromised" (e.g. Profanity weak key): inflows may be spam/attacker activity
